entries.title: Plot Seed: A New Face
entries.prompt: A courier with a half-finished tattoo waits exactly where the party will pass. They have read the room before sitting down.
entries.gmHook: Pin as a recurring NPC. GM picks gender, tone, and which faction the tattoo points to.

suggested.text: Plot seed: new courier NPC. GM names them and gives them one secret.

entries.title: Plot Seed: Smith Without a Forge
entries.prompt: Hilda introduces a smith who lost their forge and is sleeping behind the alley. They ask for a small job.
entries.gmHook: Free recurring craft NPC. Could unlock a custom weapon line.

suggested.text: Plot seed: itinerant smith. GM picks one weapon they uniquely make.

entries.title: Plot Seed: A Relic in the Snow
entries.prompt: A wax-wrapped object pokes out of fresh snow. Cold, heavy, a little wrong.
entries.gmHook: GM defines the relic later. Yellow if used; red if it whispers.

suggested.text: Plot seed: GM names the relic and one rule it breaks.

entries.title: Plot Seed: A Weapon With a Name
entries.prompt: An old weapon, signed in a smith's mark no one in town recognises.
entries.gmHook: Hand the GM a free named weapon. Roll oracle for the original wielder's last word.

suggested.text: Plot seed: GM picks weapon name and one trait it earned.

entries.title: Plot Seed: A Whispered Line
entries.prompt: A fevered patient repeats a single line that none of the local clergy can place.
entries.gmHook: Pin as a main plot thread. Promote when the party is ready.

suggested.text: A patient repeats a line none of the clergy can place.
Plot seed: red-risk main plot thread.

entries.title: Plot Seed: A Letter to Someone Here
entries.prompt: A sealed letter is addressed to one of the party. The handwriting is old.
entries.gmHook: GM picks the recipient and one childhood truth in the letter.

suggested.text: Plot seed: GM picks the recipient and what the letter admits.

entries.title: Plot Seed: A Choice That Stays
entries.prompt: The party is offered an easy out that costs someone a little of who they were.
entries.gmHook: Free character growth beat. Ties into the next scenario or chapter break.

suggested.text: Plot seed: GM picks who is offered the easy out.

entries.title: Plot Seed: A Third Faction
entries.prompt: A messenger from a faction nobody tracks waits in the corner of the tavern.
entries.gmHook: GM names the faction and one thing they want.

suggested.text: Plot seed: name the third faction and one demand they make.

entries.title: Plot Seed: A Door That Was Not There
entries.prompt: A door appears in a wall the party walked past yesterday.
entries.gmHook: Mystery seed. Promote into a scenario when the GM is ready.

suggested.text: A door is open in a wall that was solid yesterday.
Plot seed: GM decides where the door leads.

entries.title: Plot Seed: A Year Bin Cannot Account For
entries.prompt: Someone produces a contract in Bin's handwriting from a city Bin has never visited.
entries.gmHook: Heavy. Promote only if the missing-year arc is wanted.

suggested.text: Plot seed: GM picks the city and what Bin agreed to.

entries.title: Plot Seed: An Unfinished Conversation
entries.prompt: Two party members realise they were both there, on different sides, of an event neither has talked about.
entries.gmHook: Free bond beat between any two members the GM picks.

suggested.text: Plot seed: GM picks the two members and the unfinished moment.
